- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1829 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Uses unbound PR_NUMBER in the sentinel-file path without a guard.
  WHY: In non-PR runs or when PR_NUMBER is unset, the script can abort under set -u before emitting terminal failure substates.
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:120 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: TRACKING_ISSUE_NUM is never exported, so the subprocess receives an empty issue number.
  WHY: Self-heal substate events lose their tracking-issue linkage, breaking reconstruction and the test contract.
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:170-215 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The seen-file/dedupe path is shared across runs and the claim-to-emit path is not atomic.
  WHY: Parallel or re-run invocations can race, causing duplicate suppression or lost first substates.
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:328-372 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The metadata-building Python block and final record-run-event call swallow failures with `|| true`.
  WHY: Metadata build or ledger-write errors can disappear silently, so substate emission can fail while the script still exits 0.
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:284-310 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The usage parser rescans the text character-by-character and retries JSON decoding at every `{`.
  WHY: Large token logs can trigger quadratic or worse CPU time in the critical emission path.
- ai-memory/schemas/run_ledger_entry.v1.json:72-130 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new tokens object is closed with `additionalProperties: false`, making the schema non-additive for extra token fields.
  WHY: Strict JSON Schema consumers may reject entries that were intended to remain backward-compatible.

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1829 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Uses unbound PR_NUMBER variable in the sentinel file path without a guard.
  WHY: Local testing or non-PR runs can abort before emitting failure substates when the variable is used under set -u.
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:120 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: TRACKING_ISSUE_NUM is defined locally in validate_process.sh but never exported, so the subprocess sees an empty value.
  WHY: Self-heal substate events lose their tracking issue linkage because the variable is not available in the subprocess environment.
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:170-189 and 206-215 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The seen-file path is derived from RUNNER_TEMP and run_id without a per-invocation nonce, and the dedupe decision is not atomic with emission.
  WHY: Re-runs or matrix jobs can race on the same seen file, causing duplicate suppression or lost first substates.
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:328-340 and 369-372 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both the Python metadata-building block and the final ai_memory.py record-run-event call use `|| true`, swallowing errors silently.
  WHY: If metadata cannot be built or the event write fails, the script exits 0 with only a warning, so substate emission can disappear silently.
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:284-310 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The JSON parsing iterates character-by-character over the entire text, calling raw_decode at every `{` without advancing past successful parses.
  WHY: Large token logs with nested JSON objects can trigger quadratic complexity and slow ledger emission in the critical path.
- ai-memory/schemas/run_ledger_entry.v1.json:72-130, specifically the tokens object at lines 101-119 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The metadata.tokens object has `additionalProperties: false`, which rejects keys beyond input/output/total.
  WHY: Consumers using strict JSON Schema validators may reject entries that previously passed validation if they contain extra token fields, despite the change being intended as additive.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
